reviews.author: Joyce Fair
reviews.text: We had this company come out after a reference from another company we use for our heating and ac. 1st tech came out 3/12 tried to fix our clog in the kitchen sink... somehow managed to get the tool used to clear the line, into our toilet line and broke our toilet. Supervisor called my husband and informed him there were sending the tech back out with a senior tech to fix the clog and replace our now broken toilet. Today 3/13 they come back to fix the clog and replace the toilet... the clog was to difficult to fix so they had to cut the pipe to fix it. No problem there... they then fix the toilet did a horrible job caulking the toilet. My husband paid the now $1400 bill, did not receive and itemized invoice or any invoice for that matter. My husband is disabled so he could not follow them around and see what they were doing... they left all kinds of nuts and bolts and hardware for the toilet on my floor, left all of their trash laying around my bathroom, left insulation and trash all over my yard , and the tech from yesterday left grease on my kitchen floor and did not clean up after themself. I will NOT use this company ever again.

My water was shut off and I was told they would be back tomorrow and it would take approximately 6-8hrs to fix the pipe. Well. They were on site the next day and the water was back on within 24hrs of noticing the leak. To say I was impressed is an understatement. I attached some Photos of the work. They even made it look nice when they left. A++. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Raj Patel
reviews.text: Purchased a new house in January, first home without gravity fed city sewer. After the storm this past week, my private pump station failed caused sewage to back up. Ended up contacting Mt Laurel township for a suggestion on who best to work with after calling independent plumbers and electricians, Root 24 was to the rescue. Jim, Ben and David were on the scene worked extremely hard to get us back up and running. Not to mention, I walked away with some knowledge on my poop collector in the back yard. The price was high, but the service was impeccable and the gents on the scene were knowledgeable, personable and most importantly doing determined to get the job done. You guys really saved the day. To anyone reading this, if you have a pump station this is the company to work with. If you have any other issues, I’d still give them a shout because I am confident you will walk away with peace of mind. And that is priceless.

reviews.author: Christine Chung Kim
reviews.text: I wanted to check to see if there was something stuck inside my toilet since it gets backed up from time to time. When I called to inquire I was told that if there was nothing they would charge me to consultation fee of $225. Plumber came and ran an auger through to check and found nothing. He was here less than 5 min and I was charged $519. That's nearly a $300 difference. My issue is this: I talked to two different people prior to my appointment. The first said they would charge me $225, the second said it was up to the technician. When I talked to the technician at the visit, he kicked it back to the office. And just now I was billed a totally different amount. Because no one explained to me the cost of the job clearly I feel taken advantage of. I prefer to use local professionals but this just felt bad.

reviews.author: J. Lopez
reviews.text: Recently, I had the opportunity to use Root 24 for a check on our sewer system, coordinated through American Water. Initially, there was a minor hiccup; when their technician first arrived, I unfortunately missed hearing his knock, and my girlfriend hadn't listed me as a contact. However, this small issue was quickly and professionally handled by the Root 24 team. When I called their main office, I was assisted by Nick and Bridget. They were not only understanding of the situation but also extremely accommodating. Despite the missed appointment, they went out of their way to reschedule us promptly. Bridget, in particular, was exceptional in listening to my concerns and taking immediate action to rectify the situation. This level of customer service is rare and truly appreciated. The rescheduled appointment went smoothly. The technician, Nelson, was a standout professional. He not only inspected our system thoroughly but also took the time to educate us about the intricacies of various plumbing systems. His expertise and willingness to share his knowledge added significant value to the service. Nelson’s professionalism and informative approach were commendable. In conclusion, I would like to extend a heartfelt thank you to the entire Root 24 team, especially Bridget and Nelson, for their outstanding service. It’s refreshing to see a company that not only excels in their technical expertise but also places a high value on customer service and education. I highly recommend Root 24 for anyone in need of plumbing services.

reviews.author: Craig Andrews
reviews.text: I am delighted to share my experience with Root 24 drain cleaning services. Recently, I had a clogged drain in my kitchen sink that was causing a lot of problems for me. I tried various DIY methods to unclog it, but none of them seemed to work. I was about to give up when I stumbled upon Root 24's website. I was initially skeptical about their services, but after reading some positive reviews and seeing their reasonable pricing, I decided to give them a try. I called their customer service, and they were very professional and helpful. They quickly scheduled an appointment for me, and their technician arrived on time. The technician was friendly, knowledgeable, and had all the necessary tools to fix my clogged drain. He explained the problem to me and gave me a clear estimate of the cost before starting the work. I was impressed with his professionalism and attention to detail. He worked efficiently, and within no time, my drain was running smoothly again. I appreciate the prompt and reliable service that Root 24 provided. They exceeded my expectations, and I would highly recommend their services to anyone in need of drain cleaning. Their excellent customer service, reasonable pricing, and expert technicians make them stand out from the rest. Thank you, Root 24, for your outstanding work!

reviews.text: Wayne Garnett was excellent and very professional. He unclogged my sewer line in just minutes and explained where the issue was coming from. Thank You Wayne for your services this evening.

reviews.author: Sam J
reviews.text: I am compelled to leave this review after an incredibly disappointing encounter with this plumbing company. From the onset, the experience was unprofessional and a disregard for customer service. The technician arrived late without any prior communication. Upon arrival, he was discourteous and uncooperative. When I explained the problem, he seemed disinterested and unwilling to address the issue, dismissing my concerns with unwarranted arrogance. Despite multiple clear explanations about the plumbing issue needing immediate attention, the technician made no genuine effort to resolve it. Instead, he spent the time making excuses and asserting that the job was beyond the scope of what they could handle, contrary to what was previously discussed over the phone with their customer service. After a brief and cursory inspection, he claimed that additional services, which were not previously specified or quoted, would be necessary, inflating the cost unexpectedly. When I attempted to discuss this further, he was dismissive and suggested that I find another service if I was not satisfied with the quote. The technician left without doing any meaningful work. It was only a waste of time. I strongly advise against using this company. They failed to perform the basic duties they were called for, exhibited poor customer relations, and showed a total lack of professionalism.

reviews.author: Tammy Nolan
reviews.text: AJ and his crew were absolutely amazing!!! The two of them explained everything they were doing and fixed my issue totally and were the kindest workers I have ever met.

reviews.author: David Pape Jr
reviews.text: Julio and Wayne were awesome! They came in on time, knew what they were working with right away, and fixed everything in an hour. Nice guys, and excellent service :)

reviews.author: Nicole P
reviews.text: Root 24 is amazing. My first call was on Christmas Eve and Mark and Nick (Santa's helpers lol) came to scope my line, determine the issue, and temporarily clear the line. I thought having my sewer line replaced was going to be a nightmare. They were upfront about everything to expect and were spot on with their timelines. I peaked in on their progress on my Ring camera and saw my grass was dug up, concrete slab out of the walkway and a mound of mud as it was raining. This was part of what needed to be done to access the pipe. I thought, great, what a mess I'll come home to but I was pleasantly surprised. I came home from work to a fixed sewer pipe, the grass looked as if it was never even touched and the concrete was able to remain in tact and was placed and patched. They kept my mom in the loop as she was in the home. These men who worked on my property were fast, efficient, and thorough! Job well done, thanks Root 24!

reviews.author: Karl Kabi
reviews.text: This is our 2nd time with them. 1st time, technicians that came were very courteous and knowledgeable. This 2nd time, technician was able to fix the drain but in the process made the garbage disposal started leaking since he was not able to put it back properly. We asked him to try to fix it but he said it does not matter, that is a separate issue which we have to pay for, may cost about $400. We explained that leaking only started after he touched the disposal. He said none of it matters. He was very arrogant. Husband had to fix and reattach everything when he left.

reviews.author: Steve S
reviews.text: Had the company come out because a tenant needed a clog fixed on a toilet, and was under a home warranty contract. The worker "Marcus" showed up and was disrespectful to my tenant and threatened her. She asked him to put on "booties" to walk through the carpet because his boots were dirty and he said no and then told her "You're lucky your kids are here or I would have made this worse for you". He then proceeded to lazily not do his job and avoided doing the work by any means by making up excuses. His first excuse was this was an addition to the house and the "construction is different". Then he said the toilet wasn't in the contract (then I showed him where it says it was) he then said it's a "branched pipe" so it's not in the contract. I then showed them nowhere in the contract does it say that, and they could not provide the wording of where it said that (They didn't want to do the basic work they were called out to do). All they had to do was remove the toilet and snake the drain (20 mins of work even for an average joe). They refused and the technician was extremely disrespectful to me over the phone as well. I said look I can give you $100 on top just to get it done now and then he scoffed and told me it would cost way more than that. These children dressing up like adults were the worst people to have called when you need help. Scam artists. Meanwhile, they still charged the home warranty company for fixing the problem.

reviews.author: Richard Navickas
reviews.text: I can’t begin to say enough about the excellent service I received. I had spinal surgery 8 days prior and my sewer line became blocked. I couldn’t flush toilets, use the washer or run any water in the house. Following a call to American Water, Root24hrs was there within an hour. Within 24 hours an underground, broken sewer pipe was replaced and all of my service was restored. I can’t praise Zach and his partner enough. They were real life savers.I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Freddy Robinson
reviews.text: Wayne came out to fix my toilet and he did a amazing job will recommend him again.thanks root24hrs for the great service.

reviews.author: Krista Reinhardt
reviews.text: Carl was thorough and professional during his visit to our home related to issues in the first floor bathroom. Carl diagnosed the problem quickly and resolved it. Carl also removed debris related to the job. Highly recommend his work!

reviews.author: Christopher Doran
reviews.text: Guys were here on time. Did an excellent job without any need for any other supervision? Send send self-starters and finishers.

reviews.author: Dave
reviews.text: This plumbing company is the most unprofessional company I have ever had to deal with they hit the foundation of our house and then lied about it and when they backfilled the drain repair they left a mess that we couldn't deal with our gate won't open now because they left all huge rocks on top I stead of burying them and when we called to complain the guy said I saw pictures and it's fine and they were not even willing to look at it. We will be hiring a lawyer to make this right since their customer service is nonexistent. We gave them many chances to fix this issue but they won't even listen all our neighbors couldn't believe the way they left it probably because it's through insurance and they think they can do whatever they want they also left about 2 feet of old drain pipe that's lothetic to replace all the old drain pipe and leave 2 feet of old pipe I am a mechanical contractor myself , if I left jobs like this I could t live with myself now they aren't gonna have a choice .because of their neglegence.

reviews.text: Carl came out and was very friendly and professional from the very beginning. He was persistent in his work to make sure the whole line was clear. He did a very nice job

reviews.author: Eugene Mitchell
reviews.text: I call on Root24 for my plumbing inspections twice a year. My restaurant can't have any stops in service. If they say it's all good, it's all good. When issues happen, like a backflow problem or a clogged drain emergency, I don't even question who to call they get it done!

reviews.author: Kara Manton
reviews.text: I wish I could give this company 10 stars. Every single person I dealt with from start to finish was incredibly helpful and kind. I was desperate for service, they scheduled me and showed up with a couple hours to unclog my drain. Big shout out to Marisol, Woody and Susan for the amazing help and professionalism! 10/10 would recommend!! Hopefully I won't need you again, but if I do, I know I am in great hands! THANK YOU!!

reviews.text: I had the pleasure of working with Tyler, Gary n Angel this week. The guys did great work n earned all 5 stars. I highly recommend Root 24

reviews.text: I’m writing to say if you ever need a plumber call Root 24 and ask for Wayne… Very polite, Honest guy which being a woman is hard to find when you’re dealing with “ Manley Projects “ Not feeling ripped off!

reviews.text: Route 24 is the best they came out within 30 minutes and a technician named Carl was amazing. He did not stop until the job was done.

reviews.text: Gary, and Carl ,came to my property for 2 job , They did fantastic job , clean fast and problem solved . Tanent was so happy . I'm so great full of there job .

reviews.author: Victoria Schwachter
reviews.text: I can't say enough about how prompt, courteous and professional Root24 is as a company, and their Main man Tim Austin sure knows his business. He was thorough, kept the natural mess of plumbing work under control and and - most of all he explained things so I could stop worrying about hidden problems and unexpected expenses. I will recommend Root24 to anyone and everyone!!

reviews.author: dung ngo
reviews.text: Technician came out for a hydro jetting job. Ended up damage my clean out pipe and told me office will send another plumber to replace the pipe for me. My mistake is I signed the work order since the hydro jetting is done and the technician told me, he called the office and another plumber will come out and fix the damage. They left and I called the office for a time estimation. The manager denied all liability. Put it on the condition of my pipe whereas everything was fine before the service.

reviews.author: Harnold Osorio
reviews.text: This is the worst plumbing & drain cleaning company I ever seen. The technicians that came to my apartment were so UNPROFESSIONAL. Clearly they didn’t care about my property. They broke and damaged multiple things and after they finish the job they left everything so dirty. The doors, floors and walls had fingerprints and scratches. Now I’m going to hire a carpet cleaning company to also clean the carpet because their shoes were so dirty. So disappointed of this company and their technicians. Don’t waste your time and money on this company!

reviews.author: Sheree Harhay
reviews.text: I usually get a water bill for $50 a month. This month, I got a bill for $220. Placed a call on Thursday at 4 PM and Tim Austin was out the next morning. He called to say he was coming, called when he was close to my house, and then did an inspection to find the water leak. He found it under the house, took out corroded pipe and fixed it by 2 PM the same day. He worse a PPE mask, as did I, and kept my safety in mind while repairing my burst pipe! He was friendly, honest, and the cost was more than fair. I highly recommend Root 24/7 Plumbing service with a special thanks to Tim Austin. They will be my regular plumbers now. Thanks for a great job!

reviews.author: Schlegs 00
reviews.text: Wayne was absolutely amazing. Wonderful conversation and knowledgeable of his trade. Truly happy with my service.

reviews.author: Eric Barnhorst
reviews.text: My interaction with Tim Austin was top notch. Tim is very professional, knowledgeable, and fixed my issues at a reasonable price. I will be going to them for all my needs and refer everyone I know from now on.

reviews.author: Annamarie Santos
reviews.text: These folks are fabulous!!! From the office staff to the plumbers in the field. So refreshing that the service this company provides still exists. Truly great customer service and pride in what they do. Kudos to all of you! Keep up the good work!

reviews.author: Carol Miller
reviews.text: I have to say that Carl from Root24 was very efficient and kind. He cleared my sewer line and put my mind at ease. He was excellent!

reviews.author: Louis Peebles
reviews.text: We were very satisfied with the service of our broken main pipe. John & J were very professional & quick with the repair. We would highly recommend this company to any & everyone & I would not hesitate to use the service again.

reviews.author: Abigail Pawlowski
reviews.text: Wayne helped us unclog our toilet and fix the flappers, he was very nice and interactive. Very helpful

reviews.author: Jon
reviews.text: Honest company with integrity. Roto Rooter tried scamming me by saying we did not have an outdoor cleanout pipe to unclog a drain and said we had a collapsed pipe outside under the sidewalk. They were going to charge us $8.7k for a new cleanout pipe and pipe replacement. Root 24 came out to our house in a couple hours and found our cleanout pipe that was buried under some dirt and grass and cleared out our drain. They ran their camera system and also found out that our pipe was fine and wasn't broken. Work was completed within a couple hours. They should get more than 5 stars.

reviews.author: James BurnsIV
reviews.text: Root was out within half hour of our call and had us unclogged quicker than that. Couldnt be more pleased. Thank you Wayne appreciate you.

reviews.text: Very prompt service. Came out with in an hour of service call. Julio was very knowledgeable and courteous. I would highly recommend Root 24

reviews.author: Joy Jacks
reviews.text: This company saved me $6000.00 ,BECAUSE THERE HONEST AND DO A GREAT JOB ,HERES HOW. Five years ago I had a MAJOR PLUMBING promblem. It was a backup from basement sink,and roots from tree inside outside plumbing.I had insurance company involved, had to live in extendd stay for 10 days. I was told to call ben franklin plumbers. They used snake with camera 30 feet.they told me THAT my main line out side was cracked and it would cost $6000 plus. I got a second opinion from ROOT 24. THEY RAN THE SNAKE WITH CAMERA 80 FEET, AFTER CLEANING OUT THE ROOTS, THERE WAS NO CRACKED PLUMBING PROMBLEM. BEN FRANKLIN PLUMBER LIED, .Root. 24 INFORMED ME ABOUT GETTING AMERICAN WATER RESOURCES INSURANCE PLAN. I DID .I HAVE HAD ROOT 24 come 4 times in the last 5 years with different plumbing problems. THEY are professional, HONEST, PUNCTUAL, informative, and do a great job. I highly RECOMMEND THEM. Written by Joy Jacks whose beloved dad was a honest plumber too!

reviews.author: Angie Lepone
reviews.text: They came out 2times so far and our downstairs toilet is still clogged and the sink gurgling is still happening. I am not paying the bill until this is fixed. They also sent a second bill with a late charge. I don’t think so.

reviews.author: Michelle Williams

reviews.author: L Stanwyck

Root 24 office had great communication and kept me informed. There is a tracking feature so you can get an estimate on arrival time. The communications allow you to plan and is a great stress reliever. Sincere thanks Mike W
